prompts.title: LifeOS
prompts.description: Run LifeOS for work, devices and life. Say what you want; facts come from your LifeOS entity data.
prompts.content:
# LifeOS

Run /lifeos and do the task below.

* **Task:** `{{task}}`
* **Module:** `{{module}}`
* **Business:** `{{business}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`
* **Details:** `{{details}}`

Rules: ask once for anything missing, read owner facts from LifeOS entity data, and show a plan and wait for a yes before anything that creates, changes, sends, publishes or deletes. Route to the chosen stage only and load only the references it needs; this stage gate overrides any skill's own chaining. If a required input is missing, name it and stop. For a business, pick the entity from LifeOS entity data (relation owned or client); "New business" runs the add-client recipe first. Sprint and planning stages load the current LifeOS task store first: without it, tasks are silently dropped from the plan.

task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Plan my week, log today, check my backup
task.context: What you want LifeOS to do.

module.label: Module
module.context: Pick one, or Auto to let LifeOS route.
module.options:
Auto
Work
Personal
Devices
Money
Knowledge
Feed

business.label: Business
business.context: Auto picks the entity from LifeOS entity data (owned or client). New business runs onboarding first, whatever the stage. All business units is for sprint stages.
business.options:
Auto
New business (onboarding)
All business units (sprint stages)

files.label: Files
files.context: Where the current files are. Warning: sprint and planning stages without the current task store data silently drop tasks.
files.options:
None (first run)
Project files
Attached
Generated earlier in this chat

details.label: Details
details.context: Anything else LifeOS should know. Plan Week: the confirmed working days and the tasks you want. Execute: the task id. Close Day or Week: what finished, what started and did not finish, what was discovered, decisions taken. Any stage: a client task list, a freeze, an approval, a holiday or a contradiction.
